security_audit.summary: This skill contains only Markdown documentation (SKILL.md plus reference guides) — no executable scripts. All 235 static findings are false positives: they matched JavaScript template literals, example bash snippets, #!/bin/bash shebangs inside fenced code blocks, '~/.claude/' config paths, and '.env' references that appear as illustrative tutorial content, not code the skill runs. No data exfiltration, obfuscation, or prompt injection was found. The single confirmed item is the unscanned SKILL.md blind spot, which manual review confirms is benign tutorial text.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md frontmatter is not machine-parseable because a 'TRANSLATED CONTENT:' line precedes the YAML block, which prevented static scanning of that file.
remediation.suggestion:
Remove the leading 'TRANSLATED CONTENT:' line so the YAML frontmatter (---
name: ...
description: ...
---) is the first content in SKILL.md, allowing automated tooling to scan it.

remediation.issue: Example snippets show 'sudo systemctl restart postgresql' and 'rm -rf node_modules/.cache', which readers could copy and run without understanding their effect.
remediation.suggestion: Add a note near these examples clarifying that they are illustrative and should be reviewed before running, especially commands using sudo.

content.user_title: Master Claude Code with a Complete Chinese Guide
content.value_statement: Learning Claude Code advanced features from scattered notes is slow and confusing. This skill gives Claude a structured Chinese-language reference for tools, workflows, MCP, and best practices.
actual_capabilities: Explains the seven core Claude Code tools, including REPL, Artifacts, Web Search, and Web Fetch.
Describes REPL usage with preloaded libraries such as D3.js, Lodash, and MathJS.
Documents MCP server configuration and how Claude discovers MCP tools.
Covers hooks, slash commands, and multi-agent task patterns.
Provides workflows for large file analysis, debugging, and code review.
Lists best practices for permissions, performance, and error recovery.
limitations: The content is written in Chinese and does not include an English version.
It is documentation only and does not run any commands or scripts.
Some feature descriptions may lag behind the latest official Claude Code releases.
Code snippets are illustrative examples and are not tested end to end.

use_cases.title: Onboard a new Claude Code user
use_cases.description: A developer new to Claude Code reads the guide to learn the core tools and basic workflows quickly.

use_cases.title: Set up MCP integration
use_cases.description: An engineer uses the MCP section to configure a server and connect Claude to an external system.

use_cases.title: Improve daily development workflows
use_cases.description: A team lead references the workflow and best-practice sections to standardize how the team uses Claude Code.

prompt_templates.title: Learn the core tools
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this guide, explain the seven core Claude Code tools and when I should use each one.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a large file
prompt_templates.prompt: Follow the large file analysis workflow in this guide to help me review a 5000 line document.

prompt_templates.title: Configure MCP
prompt_templates.prompt: Walk me through configuring an MCP server based on the MCP section of this guide.

prompt_templates.title: Design a hooks-based automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the hooks and slash command patterns in this guide, help me design an automation that formats code and runs tests before each commit.

output_examples.input: Explain the seven core Claude Code tools and when I should use each one.
output_examples.output: Claude summarizes each tool. It explains that REPL runs JavaScript, Artifacts render visual output, and Web Search and Web Fetch gather information. It then advises which tool fits each task.

output_examples.input: Follow the large file analysis workflow to review a long document.
output_examples.output: Claude proposes a three-stage approach. First it measures the file size, then it maps the structure with heading and keyword searches, and finally it reads targeted sections for detailed review.

best_practices: State your goal clearly before asking Claude to use a specific tool.
Request only the permissions a task actually needs, such as Bash or file editing.
Review any example command carefully before running it, especially commands that use sudo.
anti_patterns: Do not paste example snippets into a terminal without reading what they do.
Do not treat the guide as current API documentation; check official docs for recent changes.
Do not grant broad file or shell access when a narrower permission would work.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It provides Claude with a structured Chinese-language guide to Claude Code tools, workflows, and best practices.

faq.question: Does this skill run any code or scripts?
faq.answer: No. It contains only Markdown documentation. It does not execute commands or scripts when installed.

faq.question: Is the content in English?
faq.answer: No. The guide is written in Chinese. It is best suited for Chinese-speaking developers.

faq.question: Why did the security scan report many findings?
faq.answer: The scanner matched code examples and file paths inside the tutorial. Manual review confirmed all of them are safe documentation examples.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: It is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code, as listed in the skill metadata.

faq.question: Is the information always up to date?
faq.answer: Not always. Claude Code updates frequently, so check the official documentation for the latest features.
